sources.publisher: CISA, FBI, NSA, EPA, INCD, CCCS, and NCSC
sources.title: Iranian IRGC-Affiliated Cyber Actors Exploit PLCs in Multiple Sectors
sources.supports: The advisory attributes attacks on Unitronics Vision Series PLCs to IRGC-affiliated cyber actors using the CyberAv3ngers persona.
sources.source_excerpt: In November 2023, IRGC-affiliated cyber actors using the persona “CyberAv3ngers” began actively targeting and compromising Israeli-made Unitronics Vision Series programmable logic controllers (PLCs) and human machine interfaces (HMIs).

sources.title: #StopRansomware: Play Ransomware
sources.supports: The advisory states that Play ransomware actors exploit Microsoft Exchange ProxyNotShell CVE-2022-41040 and CVE-2022-41082.
sources.source_excerpt: The Play ransomware group gains initial access to victim networks through the abuse of valid accounts, likely purchased on the dark web, and exploitation of public-facing applications, specifically through known FortiOS vulnerabilities and Microsoft Exchange (ProxyNotShell [CVE-2022-41040 and CVE-2022-41082]) vulnerabilities.
